content.title: Pacers vs. Cavaliers: Prediction, How to Watch for Free (4/5/26)
content.text: The Indiana Pacers (18–59) face the Cleveland Cavaliers (48–29) tonight at Rocket Arena. The Cavs enter tonight in fourth place in the Eastern Conference. With five games left in the regular season, they trail the third-place New York Knicks and have already clinched an automatic playoff berth. Cleveland comes in off a 118–111 win over the Golden State Warriors on Wednesday. Donovan Mitchell scored 25 points and Max Strus added 24, including a three-pointer with less than a minute left to seal the game. James Harden added 19 points as six Cleveland players scored in double digits and the team shot 51% from the field. The Pacers, meanwhile, fell to the Charlotte Hornets on Friday night in a 129–108 blowout loss, snapping a two-game winning streak that saw Indiana score as high as 145 points. Indiana struggled to contain Charlotte’s balanced attack, with four Hornets starters scoring 18 points or more. Pascal Siakam led the Pacers with 30 points for the second time in three games, continuing his steady play in a losing season. Obi Toppin added 11 points off the bench in an efficient 20 minutes off the bench. The Pacers have allowed 128.1 PPG over their last 10 games. Siakam is out for tonight’s game. Expect a blowout win for the Cavs as they face a Pacers team that has all but given up on defense in this final stretch of the regular season.
